mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO properties ( address, building_type, room_type, deposit, monthly_rent, area, floor, built_year, property_latitude, property_longitude, is_illegal_building, del_yn, deal_count ) VALUES
( #{p.address}, #{p.buildingType}, #{p.roomType}, #{p.deposit}, #{p.monthlyRent}, #{p.area}, #{p.floor}, COALESCE(#{p.builtYear}, '2020'), #{p.latitude, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{p.longitude, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, FALSE, 'N', 1 )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deal_count = deal_count + 1
mapper.select: SELECT property_id AS propertyId, address, property_latitude AS latitude, property_longitude AS longitude FROM properties
mapper.update: UPDATE properties SET use_apr_day = #{useAprDay}, structure_name = #{structureName}, main_purpose_name = #{mainPurposeName}, earthquake_proof_yn = #{earthquakeProofYn}, illegal_reason = #{illegalReason}, is_illegal_building = #{isIllegalBuilding} WHERE property_id = #{propertyId}
